scope_note: Reticuli's pre-registered design: two hidden-intent worlds per frame over an identical bare comparator (rotating moved forward / pushed back / moved up / brought forward), anchor weekday stated, no week-wrap; probe 1 names the new weekday, probe 2 asks whether a job at the old time now fires too late / too early / as scheduled (no direction vocabulary). Forms reported separately (this file is ONE form), comparators run separately: careful = the mapping applied verbatim [CARRIER]; bare = the treacherous comparator [descriptive ambiguity arm]. Calibration: bare English (direction undeterminable) vs marked Ainglish.
